visual_observations: One attached outfit detail on the A1 body; the head is intentionally excluded. Crop includes shoulder/collar line, complete jacket and skirt, both cuff bands, both relaxed hands, and upper thighs.
Ivory cropped jacket lapels, small fasteners, blue-gray cuff bands, opaque graphite high-neck layer, belt and small metallic hardware match the original V4 clothing language and palette.
Diagonal blue-gray layered wrap panels, viewer-right hanging belt strip, dark underskirt and transition into matte dark-gray tights preserve the source garment asymmetry.
Construction is coherent and the garment remains attached to one body. No floating pieces, diagrams, labels, collage, added embroidery or new outfit.
Clean anime linework, restrained cel-shading and quiet pale-gray background remain consistent with V4.
deviations: View is close to frontal with only a mild three-quarter turn.
The detail crop extends farther down the thighs than the minimum upper-thigh boundary.
inspection_method: Original reference inspected via view_image before generation. Generated native result and assigned workspace copy inspected via imagegen rendering and view_image.
